newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-C.BANK SAYS NO DATE FOR CREDIT RATING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-C.BANK SAYS NO DATE FOR CREDIT RATING.

text.p: The Estonian central bank said on Wednesday that no date had been set for Estonia to get a credit rating.
The bank earlier announced that it has formally decided to ask for a credit rating, putting an end to several months of speculation when and if the bank would order one.
A central bank spokesperson could not say when or how the rating could be ordered.
"The bank is certainly going to consider several offers," the spokesperson told Reuters.
The central bank earlier said it has decided to order the credit rating to help the Estonian financial sector better integrate and become more efficient.
But it also said that some of the problems that made it delay ordering the rating still exist and that it was ready at any time to apply stricter policy to ensure stable growth.
